name: smwsprites-yi-hootie-the-bluefish-piranha-fish
title: YI Hootie the Bluefish (Piranha Fish)
description:
This is based off the wall-following Urchin. It is the purple wall-following piranha plant in Naval Piranha's castle. Unlike the one in YI, this one is not compatible with slopes, so plan around that.

It requires manual GFX insertion, refer to the README. It doesn't requires it anymore, just insert it with piranhafishgfx.bin at the same folder as piranha_fish.cfg.
